title: News Events
content:
TopstepX will automatically pull in High Impact news events and plot them on your charts. This allows for quick access to see when potential marketing making moves may occur. If you click on a marker, you will see the event:
High Impact news event(s)
To remove these marks from your charts, simple right click anywhere on the chart and click " Hide Marks on Bars"
